step2.ptxt: Start the engine, select "Diagnosis" → "Vehicle Diagnosis/All DTCs" or "System Diagnosis/Chassis" → "System Name/IPA" → "DTC" on the SST (TaSCAN) screen to display the DTC check screen.

atten3.ptxt: As some DTCs are output even with no malfunction when inspecting with IG ON, always perform the inspection with the engine running.

item.ptxt: If a malfunction code is displayed, refer to the DTC Chart ().
After repair, check the DTCs again and confirm that no malfunction code is output.
